players.bio: Abdoulaye Yoro is a 19-year-old professional football player from the Ivory Coast who plays as a central midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United, on loan from Turkish side İstanbul Başakşehir.
Bert Johan Esselink (born 16 August 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Daniel Ian Bennie is a professional soccer player who plays as a winger for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United on loan from EFL Championship club Queens Park Rangers.
Dario Felix Naamo (born 14 May 2005) is a Finnish professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United, and the Finland U21 national team.

Dylan Tait (born 1 October 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club club Dundee United. Tait started his career with Raith Rovers, having first signed a senior contract in 2019. Hibernian signed him in August 2021 then loaned him back to Raith as part of the deal.
Emmanuel Agyei (born 3 November 2004) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United and the Ghana national team.
Idjessi Yethro Metsoko is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish club Dundee United, on loan from Viktoria Plzeň.
Iurie Iovu (born 6 July 2002) is a Moldovan professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United and the Moldova national team.
Jack James Walton (born 23 April 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Jesse Carmichael Randall (born 19 August 2002) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a forward for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United and the New Zealand national team.

James Michael Goodwin (born 20 November 1981) is an Irish football manager and former player who is currently the manager of Dundee United. Goodwin began his coaching career at St.Mirren as a player-coach. After a stint as assistant manager at Alloa Athletic, he became the club's manager and helped them win a promotion. He returned to St Mirren in June 2019 as manager.
Jordan Yamoah Amissah is a German professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Joshua James Rawlins (born 23 April 2004) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a right back for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Julius Eskesen is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Veikkausliiga club Kuopion Palloseura.
Kevin Andrei Ciubotaru (born 2 February 2004) is a Romanian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Lachlan Rose (born 10 May 1999) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a striker or right winger for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Lyall Cameron is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish club Dundee United on loan from Rangers.
Mehdi Merghem is an professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Michael Forbes (born 29 April 2004) is a Northern Irish footballer who plays as a centre-back for Dundee United and the Northern Ireland national team.
Miller Thomson (born 20 July 2004) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.

Neil Yves Farrugia (born 19 May 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United. Born in France, he has represented the Republic of Ireland at youth level.

Panutche Amadu Pereira Camará (born 28 February 1997) is a Bissau-Guinean professional footballer who plays as a midfielder and forward for Scottish club Dundee United and the Guinea-Bissau national team.

Ross James Graham (born 23 February 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a central defender for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United. He has also played for Elgin City, Cove Rangers and Dunfermline Athletic on loan before making his Premiership debut for Dundee United in 2022.

Vicko Ševelj (born 19 September 2000) is a Croatian professional footballer who plays as a defender for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United. Ševelj was born in Dubrovnik, living in its suburb of Mokošica, and played youth football for several local clubs before passing a trial with HNK Hajduk Split in 2015, moving to the club's youth academy in the summer of 2016.
William Ferry (born 7 December 2000) is a professional footballer who plays as a full-back for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.
Zac Sapsford is an Australian professional footballer who plays as a striker for Scottish Premiership club Dundee United.

Zidane Iqbal is a 23-year-old professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for the Dutch Eredivisie club FC Utrecht and represents the Iraq national team on the international stage. Born and raised in Manchester, England, he made history early in his career as a product of the Manchester United academy. Iqbal joined Manchester United's youth system aged nine.
